description_ja: 日本陸連公認の高速マラソン大会シリーズ「THE CHALLENGE RACE」の東京・荒川開催回です。高低差2m以内の平坦な公認コースで、目標タイム別のペーサーが配置され、給水所ではドリンクとジェルが用意されます。
description_en: This is the Tokyo Arakawa edition of THE CHALLENGE RACE, a series of fast marathon events certified by the Japan Association of Athletics Federations. It is held on a flat certified course with an elevation difference of 2 m or less. Pacers are provided for each target time, and the aid stations offer drinks and gels.
